study type: Secondary analysis of a clinical trial
cohort: The study involved 1,302 low-risk nulliparous women carrying a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation at 37-41 weeks of gestation who were enrolled in a clinical trial of early labor support in British Columbia, Canada.
finding: Advanced maternal age, shorter maternal height, greater gestational age, perception of labor lasting more than 24 hours, mild or moderate contractions, less cervical dilation, and higher fetal station at time of hospital admission independently predicted cesarean delivery.
